'''Gantel Dro''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Defel/Legends|Defel]] [[Thief/Legends|thief]] who was captured by [[Marus Grayson]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] bureaucrat, when the criminal tried to steal the [[Jewel of Yavin/Legends|Jewel of Yavin]] from him. Instead of [[Death/Legends|killing]] Dro, Grayson offered Dro the chance to live if he agreed to oversee the Jewel's security. Dro accepted the offer and accompanied Grayson to [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], where the Imperial planned to auction off the gem.
